5 pm sunday 25th october rath 9.30am mass for the people corofin 11am family/harvest mass – st. brigid’s church, corofin. sunday october 25th 11am. a meeting to finalise preparations will take place on wednesday oct. 21st 6pm in the sacristy, st. brigid’s church. rosary please join in praying the rosary each evening in october at 7pm in st brigid’s church. corofin village market sunday 18th october 10am-1pm tea/coffee, cakes, books, bric-a-brak, fruit & veg. all welcome to the community hall. the late dermot hayes rip will be honoured with a clare legacy award for his disability advocacy and community work at the clare association dublin awards dinner on saturday, 17 october, at the rine hotel, newmarket- on-fergus. friends and parishioners are warmly welcome . cumann staire is dúchais chora finne will host an illustrated talk on the unfolding story of corofin community hall 1945-2026 by gerry kennedy on thursday october 22 at 8.30pm in the hall. fáilte roimh chách evening of heritage film and talk x-po kilnaboy october 22nd 8.30 p.m.“the mud house at johnnie mac’s cross : a story from a disappearing landscape" halloween family bingo in corofin community hall on friday 23rd october at 7pm and all proceeds go to the corofin national school. great prizes on the night. all support greatly appreciated . corofin library bookclub is on thursday the 29th of october. visit corofin library for the book for october
